name: Results drift with delivery buying
author: claude
hypothesis: A 5%+ results-day jump on 3x turnover, closing near the high, with delivery well above normal (real buyers, not traders), keeps drifting up for two weeks while NIFTY is above its 200-day average.
filter: days_since_result == 0 and result_ret >= {jump} and result_turn_mult >= {vol} and result_close_loc >= 0.8 and deliv_z > {dz} and nifty_above_ma200 == 1
